author: Marcus Rockel
title: Rank weighting and asymmetry in Blest’s rank correlation: two exact regions
license: Original article copyright retained by the author; included at the author’s request.
changes: The whole statement and proof of Corollary 3.2 are retained in the comparison column, from the published version of 23 September 2026.
The two scalar branch expressions are named g₋ and g₊. Derivative existence, strict monotonicity, and every equality case are explicit.
Attainment and uniqueness are expressed as equivalences; the extremizers’ coefficient values and support graphs are included.
Copulas are identified with their probability laws. Supported on a graph is interpreted as probability one on that graph; the graphs here are closed.
Theorem 1.1, Lemma 3.1 and the survival identities remain compiled dependencies, as they are cited dependencies in the printed proof.
